_about: Fork: the fictional web of the brain eval (scripts/brain_fake_searxng.py, scripts/brain_eval.py). Every place, shop, product and event here is made up, so a model can only know it by searching. A query matches an entry when it contains one of the entry's terms; entries are ranked by matched terms, then topics, then their order here. Placeholders: {{date+N}} (Sunday 1 November 2026), {{iso+N}} (2026-11-01), {{weekday+N}} (Sunday), {{year}}, counted in days from the server's today.

entries.title: Marrowby's Bicycle Workshop, Velmora: repairs, opening hours
entries.snippet: Marrowby's Bicycle Workshop, 4 Tannery Lane, Velmora. Opening hours: Monday to Friday 08:30 to 17:30, Saturday 10:00 to 14:00, closed on Sundays. Brake and gear repairs while you wait.

entries.title: Spokewright Cycles Velmora: bike repair and rental, open Sundays
entries.snippet: Spokewright Cycles, 19 Quayside Row, Velmora. Bike repair, tune-ups and rentals. Open every day; Sunday 11:00 to 16:00. Weekdays 09:00 to 18:00.

entries.title: Quillfeather 7.3 released: offline handwriting sync | Brindlewood Labs
entries.snippet: Brindlewood Labs released Quillfeather 7.3, the latest version of its note-taking app, on 20 October 2026. New: offline handwriting sync and a lasso-to-text tool. Quillfeather Pro costs 29 euros a year; the basic app stays free.

entries.title: Lanternfall Festival {{year}} in Velmora: date, venue, line-up
entries.snippet: The Lanternfall Festival returns to Harbour Square, Velmora, on {{date+7}} from 18:00. Headliner: The Copper Wrens. Lantern parade at 20:30. Free entry.

entries.title: Velmora to Isle of Tamsk ferry: timetable and fares | Tamsk Ferry Co.
entries.snippet: Ferries from Velmora harbour to the Isle of Tamsk leave daily at 07:15, 11:40 and 16:05 (crossing 55 minutes). Adult single ticket 12.50 euros, bicycles free.
